why.heading: Why did my balance change?
flow.ACCOUNT_AND_POLICY: Checking your account and the policy
confirm.title: Confirm this fix
confirm.body: Nothing has changed yet. This runs only when you confirm.
sources.title: Sources
sources.note: Each source is shown with its version so you can check it.
handoff.title: A person is taking this on
handoff.body: Your case has gone to the {queue} team. Nothing you have told me is lost.
refused.title: I did not send that
refused.body: I could not answer that safely, so I have not guessed. A person can help.
voice.title: Speak to Clarity
voice.hint: Ask about a charge, your balance or a pack.
voice.notice: Your browser turns speech into text. In Chrome or Safari, the audio goes to Google or Apple for this, not to Hutch. Only the text is sent to Clarity, and you can check it first.
voice.error.denied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or type your question.
voice.error.nospeech: I did not hear anything. Try again, or type your question.
voice.error.unavailable: Voice input is not available right now. Please type your question.
